description: Show Vayu's short guided pause in a timer: three settling prompts (settle the body, soften the senses, meet the breath), then a few slow 4-2-4-2 breaths and one release breath. Sessions: morning (start the day), midday (a reset), stress (stress relief) and bedtime (wind down before bed). Use it when the user wants a quick guided break or reset rather than a specific technique. Takes about 1 to 3 minutes. It is a relaxation exercise, not medical treatment. Nothing is saved.

breaths.description: How many counted breaths, each about 12 seconds: 3, 6, 9 or 12. Defaults to 3.

session.description: morning: start the day calmly. midday: a midday reset. stress: stress relief. bedtime: wind down before bed.
